# Tristan Reddan

> Dr Tristan Reddan is a Clinical Associate Professor, sonographer and radiographer in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. His work covers paediatric diagnostic ultrasound, regional and First Nations access to imaging, patient safety, and the sonographer workforce.

This site is a professional record with links to primary sources where they exist. Current roles and affiliations are on LinkedIn.

## Pages
- [Home](https://tristanreddan.github.io/): profile links, upcoming talks, and contact
- [Research](https://tristanreddan.github.io/research.html): research themes and a case study on inter-hospital transfers of children with abdominal pain
- [Teaching and academia](https://tristanreddan.github.io/teaching.html): teaching, academic work, and eight papers led by first-time and early-career authors
- [Regional education](https://tristanreddan.github.io/regional.html): regional and rural paediatric ultrasound workshops since 2016, with a table of local workforce and ABS 2021 Census context
- [Presentations](https://tristanreddan.github.io/presentations.html): upcoming and past talks, keynotes and conference presentations
- [Recognition and service](https://tristanreddan.github.io/recognition.html): awards, grants, editorial and professional service
